title: Settings Update Apply Operator UX Redesign and Login UX Polish
summary: Redesigns the Settings maintenance update-apply operator view, hides technical diagnostics in healthy states, and remembers the last successful login username locally without storing passwords.
changelog: Redesigns Settings maintenance update apply into a polished operator-facing flow with release, progress and result sections.
Hides raw diagnostics in healthy update states and keeps commit verification in the latest progress summary.
Removes the hardcoded admin login default and remembers only the last successful username in the local browser.
